content.text: In countries like Zimbabwe, where financial isolation and platform restrictions are a harsh reality, digital creators face significant barriers to [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-digital-art-without-paypal-explained-digital-creators-6|Selling Digital]] their products online. With Stripe and PayPal often unavailable, creators must seek alternative infrastructure solutions to accept [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-infrastructure-south-asian-creators-my-unfiltered-take-3|COREMERCH guide to payment]]-gateways-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-8|crypto]] payments and maintain ownership of their data. This guide will walk you through building a crypto store on Cloudflare Pages, empowering you to take control of your digital commerce.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The key to a successful digital store lies in its infrastructure. By leveraging Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, you can create a scalable and secure platform that accepts crypto payments via NOWPayments. This stack is particularly useful for creators in regions where traditional payment gateways are restricted, as it provides a reliable and efficient way to process transactions. With the Edge Commerce Stack, you can have a fully operational store up and running in just 48 hours.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your crypto store, you'll need to gather a few essential components. First, you'll need a Cloudflare account and a basic understanding of how to use their platform. You'll also need to set up a Supabase instance to store your orders and product information. Additionally, you'll need to create a NOWPayments account to enable crypto payment processing. With these components in place, you can begin building your store using the Edge Commerce Stack template.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up your payment and delivery pipeline is a critical step in deploying your crypto store. You'll need to configure your NOWPayments account to work with your Cloudflare Pages store, and set up a system for delivering digital products to your customers. This can be done using Cloudflare Workers to automate the delivery process, ensuring that customers receive their products instantly after payment confirmation. With the Edge Commerce Stack, this process is streamlined and efficient, allowing you to focus on selling your products rather than managing the technical details.
Build a crypto store that accepts payments in 300+ cryptocurrencies with no KYC required.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've set up your store and configured your payment and delivery pipeline, it's time to go live and start processing transactions. This involves testing your store on the mainnet to ensure that everything is working as expected. With the Edge Commerce Stack, you can be confident that your store has been thoroughly tested and is ready for launch. As you process your first transaction, you'll see the power of your new infrastructure in action, with crypto payments being processed seamlessly and digital products being delivered instantly.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your store grows and you begin to process more transactions, you'll need to scale your infrastructure to keep up with demand. This involves optimizing your Cloudflare Workers and Supabase instance to handle increased traffic and orders. With the Edge Commerce Stack, you'll have access to a scaling playbook that provides guidance on how to optimize your infrastructure for maximum performance. By following these best practices, you can ensure that your store remains fast, secure, and reliable, even as you continue to grow and expand your customer base.

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, you can use the Edge Commerce Stack, which includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. This stack provides a scalable and secure platform for processing transactions and delivering digital products, all without the need for traditional payment gateways. Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your crypto store, start by setting up your Cloudflare account and creating a new page. Next, configure your Supabase instance to store your orders and product information. Then, set up your NOWPayments account and configure it to work with your Cloudflare Pages store. After that, use Cloudflare Workers to automate the delivery process, and test your store on the mainnet to ensure everything is working as expected. Finally, go live and start processing transactions, using the scaling playbook to optimize your infrastructure as you grow. With these steps, you can have a fully operational crypto store up and running in no time.
